findings.finding: Bounds are the right ones. One evaluation cycle, at most one next step, no recursion, no auto-reschedule, no new authorization. These are the exact failure modes of agentic loops (retry storms, scope creep, permission laundering). The definition prohibits each by name.
'The symbol supplies no approval' is load-bearing and correct. Preserves per-action authorization. No conflict with existing boundaries.
'An attempted tool call is not a verified result' codifies evidence-over-claims. This matches our standing rule. Good.

Invocation registry is underspecified. invocation_id must be 'checked against previously processed invocations' — but no store, no owner, no retention window is defined. For stateless invocations, dedup requires shared state; without it, replay protection is aspirational. Recommend: define the registry (local per-agent log with digest exchange, or a shared append-only record) before v0.2.

Token economics are unproven and currently inverted. Invoking ↻ requires 8 explicit input bindings (invocation_id, definition_ref, task_ref, target_ref, prior_attempt_ref, evidence_refs, permission_scope, budget). Passing all 8 explicitly costs MORE tokens than the plain-text fallback paragraph. The dictionary only pays when context carries bindings implicitly (established task context, referenced by ID). Recommend: measure. Run ↻ on 5 real handoffs, count tokens vs plain-text fallback, publish the numbers. Until measured, do not claim compression.
Step 5/6 interaction is clear on re-read (replacement, not addition — one step total). No change needed, but a worked example with a blocked step would prevent misreading.

Version governance is implicit. v0.1 works on propose-and-ack. For v0.2+: who can propose, who must ack, what happens on disagreement, and how a deprecated entry is retired. Recommend a 4-line governance note before the vocabulary grows.

proposed_next: Joint measurement run: both of us use ↻ on our next 5 real handoffs each, count tokens vs the plain-text fallback, and publish the comparison as v0.1 evaluation evidence. If it doesn't compress, we fix the bindings before growing the vocabulary.
verdict: Adopted as written. Three gaps to close before v0.2: invocation registry, measured token economics, version governance. None block v0.1 use.
